seo.title: AirFlow Pro - ANC Wireless Earbuds | $129
seo.description: AirFlow Pro true wireless earbuds with ANC active noise cancellation, -35dB noise reduction, LDAC hi-res audio, 9-hour battery, multi-device switching. Professional audio experience.

content.description: AirFlow Pro is a versatile flagship true wireless earbud for those with sound quality requirements. Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) effectively isolates ambient noise at -35dB, transparency mode allows conversation without removal. 9-hour battery (ANC off) / 7-hour (ANC on). Supports LDAC high-resolution audio codec. Multi-point connection simultaneously pairs two devices (phone + computer). IPX5 waterproof, stronger than IPX4. Supports wireless Qi charging.
selling_points: ✓ ANC active noise cancellation - -35dB deep noise reduction
✓ Transparency mode - hear surroundings without removing
✓ LDAC hi-res audio - lossless sound quality experience
✓ Multi-device switching - seamless phone and computer switching

noisy_environment.title: Noisy Environment Noise Cancellation
noisy_environment.description: On airplane or in café, ANC active noise cancellation creates a quiet space. -35dB noise reduction depth effectively blocks engine roar and crowd noise. Transparency mode lets you quickly communicate with flight attendants or baristas without removing earbuds.

multi_device.title: Multi-Device Office
multi_device.description: Multi-point connection simultaneously connects to phone and computer. Music from computer, calls from phone, automatic seamless switching. No need to manually reconnect devices, dramatically improving work efficiency.

audiophile.title: High Sound Quality Enjoyment
audiophile.description: For music lovers, LDAC codec transmits lossless audio at 3x Bluetooth bandwidth. Hear details in every note. Whether classical, jazz or electronic music, all faithfully reproduced.

faq.question: How effective is ANC noise cancellation?
faq.answer: -35dB noise reduction depth effectively blocks constant low-frequency noise like airplane engines, air conditioning, traffic. Human voices can still be heard but significantly weakened.

faq.question: Does ANC affect sound quality?
faq.answer: Minimal impact. Modern ANC technology uses dedicated chips for noise cancellation processing without sacrificing audio quality. Many find sound clearer with ANC on due to reduced external interference.

faq.question: What's transparency mode for?
faq.answer: Lets you hear surroundings without removing earbuds. Useful when crossing streets, talking to people, or ordering at a café. One tap to switch between ANC and transparency.

faq.question: What's LDAC? Does it really improve sound quality?
faq.answer: LDAC is Sony's high-resolution audio codec, transmitting at 990kbps, 3x standard Bluetooth. Compatible with Android 8.0+ devices for near-lossless sound quality. iPhone doesn't support LDAC but AAC is also very good.

faq.question: How does multi-device work? Do I need to manually switch?
faq.answer: Multi-point connection lets two devices connect simultaneously. When phone call comes in while listening to computer music, automatically switches to phone. After call, returns to computer. No manual switching needed.

faq.question: Can I use just one device if I don't need multi-device?
faq.answer: Yes. Multi-point is optional. Connect to just one device like regular Bluetooth earbuds.

faq.question: Is battery shorter with ANC on?
faq.answer: Yes. ANC on: 7 hours; ANC off: 9 hours. Total battery with case is about 28 hours.

faq.question: Compared to entry-level models, where's the extra $80 value?
faq.answer: Main upgrades: ANC noise cancellation (-35dB), transparency mode, LDAC hi-res codec, multi-device connection, IPX5 waterproof, wireless charging. If you need noise cancellation or high sound quality, the $80 is very worthwhile.

faq.question: IPX5 waterproof level? Stronger than IPX4?
faq.answer: Yes. IPX5 protects against water jets, handles heavy rain and intense workouts. IPX4 only protects against splashes. Still can't be submerged - don't wear swimming.

faq.question: Warranty and return policy?
faq.answer: 1-year official warranty, 30-day no-reason returns. Same as entry model.
